needs.proposedSignature: AltCost `{ id: 'suspend', label, cost: ManaCost, from: 'hand', timeCounters: number }` (mirroring the existing `impending` altCost, which already carries `timeCounters` and is ticked in game.ts:462/765) + effect `{ op: 'suspend-self', counters: Amount }` + trigger `{ on: 'last-time-counter-removed', self: boolean }` + condition `{ kind: 'suspended', least?: number }` + TargetSpec kind `'suspended-card'` + covers kind `suspend` (or an extra altCosts row) with the anchored shape `^suspend (\d+)[—-] ?(\{.+\})$`, matching on `timeCounters` and `cost.mana.raw`.
needs.semantics: Suspend N—[cost] is three abilities (CR 702.62a): a static ability in hand — if you could begin to cast this card from hand you may pay [cost] and exile it with N time counters on it, not using the stack; a triggered ability in exile — at the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is suspended, remove a time counter from it; and a triggered ability — when the last time counter is removed, if it's exiled, you may play it without paying its mana cost, and a creature spell cast this way gains haste until you lose control of it. A card is 'suspended' while it is in exile, has suspend and has a time counter on it (CR 702.62b).
